title: Peaceful Players
description: Let new players enjoy Minecraft without hostile mob stress! Mobs ignore peaceful players until attacked - perfect for family servers.
body:
# Perfect for Family-Friendly Servers

**Peaceful Players** lets players enjoy Minecraft without the stress of hostile mob attacks. Toggle peaceful mode and mobs will ignore you completely - walk past zombies, skeletons, and creepers like they don't exist!

**New players start in peaceful mode by default.**

## Features

### Mobs Ignore You
When peaceful mode is enabled, hostile mobs won't target you. Explore caves, build at night, and enjoy the world without constant combat.

### Fair Revenge System
Attack a mob and *only that specific mob* can fight back. Hit one zombie out of five? Only that zombie will chase you - the others stay neutral.

### Death Protection
Peaceful players keep their inventory and XP when they die. No more losing your hard-earned items!

### No Hunger Loss
Peaceful players never lose hunger from sprinting, jumping, or other activities.
The food bar stays constant, mimicking vanilla peaceful mode behavior.
Players can still eat to restore hunger if it was already low before enabling peaceful mode.

### Configurable Damage Reduction
Server admins can set damage reduction (0-100%) for peaceful players in the config.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/peaceful` | Toggle between peaceful and survival mode |
| `/peaceful peaceful` | Enable peaceful mode |
| `/peaceful survival` | Enable survival mode |
| `/peacefullist` | List all peaceful players |

## Perfect For

- **Family servers** - Let kids play without frustration
- **Creative builders** - Focus on building, not fighting
- **New players** - Learn the game at your own pace
- **Mixed servers** - Each player chooses their own difficulty

## Open Source

MIT license. Contributions welcome on [GitHub](https://github.com/HomeCraftMC/peaceful-players)!
